name: Post-build preview verification
description: The post-build preview check validates the pinned export, generated localized /methods pages, and semantic 404 page; repository:check enforces preview and secret boundaries. Playwright’s worker starts a fresh build and tests the actual unknown-route HTTP 404, so do not use stale dist output as evidence.

outcomes.notes: Updated to the current post-build preview contract. npm run build, preview-check, repository-check, and admin-routing check passed; npm test passed 43/43.
outcomes.test_results: Wrangler Pages preview GET /no-such-route returned HTTP 404 with branded Page not found content. Full Playwright suite not run: Chromium executable is absent in host cache.

name: Preview exclusion gate
description: The preview quality contract now ends with repository:check, a deterministic scan that rejects secret-like files and assignments, private-key markers, generated deployment/Tina configuration, and non-placeholder site configuration; preview route checks remain fixture-backed and production integrations stay excluded.

outcomes.notes: Current repository:check scanned 198 source files; preview exclusions and secret boundaries are green.

name: Preview unknown-route HTTP contract
description: The deterministic preview check validates dist/404.html for semantic accessible branded output, then starts the built Astro preview and asserts GET /no-such-route returns HTTP 404 with the not-found heading and home link. This keeps the status contract covered without deployment configuration.

outcomes.notes: The live local preview behavior still matches the unknown-route 404 contract. Built with current source and queried via local Wrangler Pages.
outcomes.test_results: GET /no-such-route -> HTTP 404; response includes Page not found. Playwright browser suite could not launch because Chromium is absent.

name: Tina dev generation boundary
description: The Tina Astro dev command generates tina/tina-lock.json plus transient tina/__generated__ and public/admin artifacts; track the lockfile and ignore the generated runtime artifacts. The minimal web schema models the pinned senshac-content export without adding Pages, DNS, or credentials.

outcomes.notes: Fresh local production build completed Tina generation, Astro build, Pages normalization, and Tina admin normalization; generated artifacts remain ignored while tina/tina-lock.json stays tracked.
outcomes.test_results: npm run build succeeded; node scripts/check-tina-lock.mjs passed (8 collections).

name: Bun-based web contract workflow
description: The modular senshac-web contract workflow installs from the committed bun.lock with bun install --frozen-lockfile and executes bun run quality while retaining the immutable senshac-runner image and repository contract checks; the package build script remains astro build for Pages consistency.

outcomes.notes: Current CI installs from bun.lock with bun install --frozen-lockfile and runs bun run quality; package and workflow contracts remain consistent.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; npm run build succeeded.

content: Agent guidance is standardized in AGENTS.md with the portable .agents/skills/bounded-warren-task/SKILL.md; keep .warren/config.yaml free of defaultProvider/defaultModel/agentImage overrides, with image and provider/model choices owned by Warren instances and agent definitions.

outcomes.notes: Current AGENTS.md and curated skills retain bounded Warren task guidance; .warren/config.yaml only sets role, branch, and prefix and contains no provider/model/image overrides.

title: Record modular cutover acceptance boundary
rationale: The final web review records deterministic route, content, Tina lock, safety, and quality evidence while explicitly leaving live platform, manual accessibility/SEO, media, and rollback rehearsal actions with owners. Keep tracker senshac-workspace-c714 in the delivery commit.

outcomes.notes: Workspace Seed senshac-workspace-c714 remains open and blocked by c9f9 and 83d8; the acceptance boundary still defers production, accessibility, media, and rollback proof to owners.
outcomes.test_results: seeds show senshac-workspace-c714 confirms current acceptance and blockers.

title: Use devenv as the web repository environment boundary
rationale: The web repository now declares its local Bun, Node.js, and quality-toolchain packages in devenv.nix and no longer tracks a Flox manifest; Tina credentials remain process-environment-only and the existing bun quality workflow stays unchanged.

description: Playwright test:e2e can serve stale dist: its webServer guard checks only whether dist/ exists, so a Sep 27 artifact bypassed the Oct 8 source build and produced false inquiry/UI failures.
resolution: Build dist from current source before Playwright E2E, or validate artifact freshness; rerun the same inquiry E2E after rebuilding. Confirmed: stale dist yielded 4 failures; rebuilt dist yielded 5/5 passes.

outcomes.notes: Changed Playwright webServer to always run bun run build. Verified same inquiry-and-expansion E2E suite succeeds.
outcomes.test_results: devenv shell -- bun run test:e2e e2e/inquiry-and-expansion.spec.ts: 5 passed, 0 failed (48.1s)

content: Use the current AGENTS.md and curated .agents/skills as the authoritative source for Senshac web workflow; avoid stale tool-specific snippets when guidance changes, follow the named quality gates, and keep production credentials and config out of the repository.

outcomes.notes: Verified against the current AGENTS.md and the repository's curated skills; this replaces the stale repository-local CLI guidance.
outcomes.test_results: Reviewed AGENTS.md, .agents/skills, and all six main worktree status snapshots.

name: Pinned editorial export boundary
description: The runtime route consumes senshac-content-export.json through src/content/adapter.mjs, which validates the pinned contract version and full source revision; test/content.test.mjs covers ready, stale, missing, error, project-route, and no-environment/network boundaries.

outcomes.notes: Current adapter and routes match the replacement contract, and the fixture remains test-only.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; npm run build succeeded.
